title: Explainable Multimodal Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Dependency-guided Large Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2601.06848v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal aspect-based sentiment analysis (MABSA) aims to identify aspect-level sentiments by jointly modeling textual and visual information, which is essential for fine-grained opinion understanding in social media. Existing approaches mainly rely on discriminative classification with complex multimodal fusion, yet they lack explicit sentiment explainability. In this paper, we reformulate MABSA as a generative and explainable task, proposing a unified framework that simultaneously predicts aspect-level sentiment and generates natural language explanations. Based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), our approach employs a prompt-based generative paradigm, jointly producing sentiment and explanation. To further enhance aspect-oriented reasoning capabilities, we propose a dependency-syntax-guided sentiment cue strategy. translated_title: 基于依存句法引导大语言模型的可解释多模态方面级情感分析
translated_abstract: 多模态方面级情感分析（MABSA）旨在通过联合建模文本和视觉信息来识别方面级情感，这对于社交媒体中的细粒度观点理解至关重要。现有方法主要依赖于采用复杂多模态融合的判别式分类，然而它们缺乏显式的情感可解释性。在本文中，我们将MABSA重新表述为一个生成式且可解释的任务，提出了一个统一框架，该框架能够同时预测方面级情感并生成自然语言解释。基于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs），我们的方法采用基于提示的生成范式，联合产生情感预测和解释。为了进一步增强面向方面的推理能力，我们提出了一种依存句法引导的情感线索策略。该策略对以方面为中心的依存句法树进行剪枝和文本化，引导模型辨别……
tldr: 该论文将多模态方面级情感分析重新定义为生成式可解释任务，提出基于多模态大语言模型并融合依存句法引导策略的统一框架，在预测方面级情感的同时生成自然语言解释。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates MABSA as a generative and explainable task, proposing a unified framework based on multimodal large language models with a dependency-syntax-guided strategy that jointly predicts aspect-level sentiment and generates natural language explanations.
